test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Reds are Emeralds.

No Emeralds are Magentas.

All Magentas are Greens.

Conclusion (I): Some Magentas are Emeralds

Conclusion (II): Some Emeralds are Greens
solution:
**Statements:**

Some Reds are Emeralds.

No Emeralds are Magentas.

All Magentas are Greens.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9e7339ef9c8b77c638d62494854dfb25ebba74ff363a65a99dd27952ea0bdb9.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Magentas are Emeralds. - Does not follow (Because, no Emeralds are Magentas, so no Magentas and Emeralds.)

(II) Some Emeralds are Greens. - Does not follow (There is no definite relation between Emeralds and Greens, it can be possible but it is not definite.)

Thus, neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
